description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class 'ListViewDeletion' that demonstrates how to delete items from a ListView with animations, including managing view recycling issues during animations. It includes control logic for deleting selected list items, handling view animations, and tracking checked views.

classes.name: ListViewDeletion
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating animated deletion and recycling management in a ListView.
